title: Zscaler EOS and EOL Policy: SaaS, software and hardware-refresh milestones

prose.label: Software Products.
prose.text: {{software-support}} {{software-support-ticket}} {{software-eos-eol}} The Supported Versions page covers only some products {{gap:supported-versions-list}}; for Cloud Connector see [[cloud-connector.upgrades.os-images]].

prose.label: Hardware.
prose.text: {{hw-refresh-date}} {{hw-return}} {{hw-eol}} The hardware terms themselves are in [[portfolio.usage-terms.hardware]].

effective.statement: The EOS and EOL Policy states it is effective as of August 1st, 2017 and covers Zscaler SaaS Products, Zscaler Software Products and Zscaler Hardware.

quotes: This policy is effective as of August 1st, 2017.
1. Zscaler SaaS Products
2. Zscaler Software Products
3. Zscaler Hardware

saas-eos.statement: For a SaaS Product, Zscaler notifies at least 90 days before End-of-Sale; after EOS the product is unavailable for new orders but may be renewed or extended with more users through its EOL date, with support until EOL.

quotes: Zscaler notification at least 90 days before EOS
SaaS Product is no longer available for new orders.
the SaaS Product may be renewed to extend an existing contract or to add more users through its EOL date
Zscaler will continue to provide support for the Product until the EOL for the Product.

saas-eol.statement: A SaaS Product's EOL is at least 1 year after its EOS date; after EOL the SaaS Product is no longer available, but customers with contracts extending beyond it are offered an upgrade path or replacement, or Zscaler supports the current Product until the end of the then-current contract term without renewal.

quotes: EOL at least 1 year after the EOS date
After EOL, the SaaS Product will no longer be available

customers with existing contracts that extend beyond the EOL date will be offered either an upgrade path or replacement or Zscaler will support the current Product until the end of the then-current contract term without renewal

software-support.statement: In general, Zscaler supports the latest Software version and the two previous versions of each Software Product, although it may designate another version as supported and notes this at Supported Versions.

quotes: In general, Zscaler supports the latest Software version and the two previous versions for each Software Product.
In some cases, Zscaler may designate another version as a supported version and will note this at Supported Versions.

software-support-ticket.statement: Zscaler Support will request an upgrade to a Supported Version before beginning troubleshooting, and Supported Versions are eligible for patch and maintenance upgrades until the EOL of the Product.

quotes: Zscaler Support will request that customers and partners upgrade to a Supported Version before beginning troubleshooting.
Software Product Supported Versions are eligible for patch and maintenance upgrades until the EOL of the Product.

software-eos-eol.statement: For Software Products, Zscaler notifies at least 60 days before EOS and EOL is at least 6 months after the EOS date; EOS products are no longer available for purchase or download, and after EOL they are no longer eligible for patch, maintenance upgrades or support and have no supported versions.

quotes: Zscaler notification at least 60 days before EOS
EOL at least 6 months after the EOS date
EOS Software Products are no longer available for purchase or download by customers or partners.
After EOL, the Software Product is no longer eligible for patch or maintenance upgrades or support, and no longer has any supported versions.

hw-refresh-date.statement: Hardware Refresh applies to Zscaler-owned hardware; the Refresh Date is in most cases about 5 years from the subscription start date, though Zscaler may refresh hardware at any time, and Zscaler notifies at least 90 days before it.

quotes: In most cases, about 5 years from the subscription start date for the Zscaler-owned hardware
Zscaler may refresh hardware at any time to support new innovations.
Zscaler notification at least 90 days before Refresh Date

hw-return.statement: The Hardware Return Date is, unless otherwise agreed, a maximum of 90 days after the Refresh Shipment Date; SLAs are not available for Products running on hardware used after the Hardware Return Date, and, at Zscaler's option, hardware not returned within 90 days from the Hardware Return Date may be subject to additional asset recovery mitigation.

quotes: Unless otherwise agreed to by Zscaler, a maximum of 90 days after the Refresh Shipment Date
Zscaler Service Level Agreements (SLAs) will not be available to Products running on hardware being used after its Hardware Return Date.
At Zscaler’s option, hardware not returned to Zscaler within 90 days from the Hardware Return Date may be subject to additional asset recovery mitigation.

hw-eol.statement: Specific hardware may have an EOL date, the latest date it can be used in production, which unless there is an urgent reason to refresh sooner is 1 year after the Refresh Date; SLAs are not available to Products on hardware used after its EOL date.

quotes: EOL 1 year after Refresh Date
which is the latest date the hardware can be used in production
the EOL date will be 1 year after the Refresh Date
SLAs are not available to Products running on hardware being used after its EOL date.

disclaimer.statement: The policy's general disclaimer says that, subject to the details where use of the Products is permitted after an EOL date, use of Products past the EOL date, or the Hardware Return Date for hardware, results in invalidation of all Service Level Agreements and service credits for the Products.

quotes: SUBJECT TO THE ABOVE DETAILS WHERE USE OF THE PRODUCTS IS PERMITTED AFTER AN EOL DATE
SUCH USE PAST THE EOL DATE OR HARDWARE RETURN DATE SHALL RESULT IN THE INVALIDATION OF ANY AND ALL SERVICE LEVEL AGREEMENTS AND SERVICE CREDITS FOR THE PRODUCTS.

supported-versions-list.title: Supported versions of Software Products the Supported Versions page does not list
supported-versions-list.detail: The Supported Versions page (supported-versions-20260909.json) is captured and lists Client Connector, Internet & SaaS Virtual Service Edge, NSS, Index Tool, ZAB, Incident Receiver, Cloud Connector and Branch Connector. It lists no version for Zscaler Analyzer, Shift, Office365Mon, CIEM or SecureAgent, so the policy and these pages do not say which versions of other Software Products are supported. Cloud Connector versions are in cloud-connector.upgrades.os-images.
